If a Blue-Eyes is already in your GY, Roar can bring that one back instead.

combos.h: Line D — Indigo-Eyes for 8000 (going second)
combos.about: Two Blue-Eyes White Dragons overlay into Indigo-Eyes Silver Dragon. When it is Xyz Summoned it negates **every face-up card** your opponent controls. It then detaches a Blue-Eyes and revives it with 1000 extra ATK. Two 4000 ATK Dragons deal exactly 8000.

steps.t: Activate Wishes: discard 1 card and **add Sage and Roar**. Activate Roar: Special Summon Blue-Eyes from your Deck.
**Normal Summon Sage** (add Maiden), then Link Summon Spirit with Eyes of Blue using Sage and add Mausoleum.
Activate Mausoleum. Its effect **sends a second Blue-Eyes** from your Deck to the GY.
Tribute Spirit with Eyes of Blue: **Special Summon that Blue-Eyes** from your GY.
**Xyz Summon Indigo-Eyes Silver Dragon** using both Blue-Eyes. Its effect negates all face-up cards they control.
Detach 1 Blue-Eyes, then **Special Summon it from the GY** with 1000 extra ATK (4000).
**Attack with Indigo-Eyes (4000) and Blue-Eyes (4000).**

end.t: Their whole field is negated for the turn and you attack for 8000. Indigo-Eyes still has one Blue-Eyes attached, which it needs in order to attack directly.

rules: Don't use Lordly Lode's Summon effect this turn. It would stop Indigo-Eyes from activating its negate.
Each Indigo-Eyes effect is once per turn.
If they still have monsters, use Lightning Storm or Majesty of the White Dragons first so the attacks are direct.

primite-blue-eyes.arch: Blue-Eyes White Dragon Synchro/Fusion control with a Primite Normal-Monster sub-engine.

swordsoul-tenyi.pitch: A Synchro deck with very simple arithmetic. Each **Swordsoul** monster creates a Swordsoul Token, a Level 4 Tuner. Token + monster becomes a Level 8 or Level 10 Wyrm Synchro, and the monster used as material gives a bonus. The **Tenyi** Spirits add free Summons, and the deck carries a heavy set of going-second cards.

plan.first: Make **Chixiao** (Level 8) and a Level 10: **Chengying** or **Qixing Longyuan**. On their turn Chixiao negates a monster, and banishing a card for that negate triggers Chengying to banish 2 more of theirs.
plan.second: Harpie's Feather Duster or Evenly Matched first. Incredible Ecclesia Summons herself because they control more monsters, then **Baxia** shuffles their cards into the Deck and Chixiao negates what remains.
plan.win: Two or three Synchros with 2800 to 3500 ATK. Longyuan deals 1200 damage each time it is used as Synchro Material, which adds up quickly.

open.t: Normal Summon it and reveal a Swordsoul card or Wyrm from your hand: you get a Token, and Mo Ye draws when used as material.
Adds any Swordsoul monster. Once you control a Synchro Monster it adds any Wyrm, including the Tenyi.
Discard another Swordsoul card or Wyrm to Summon it **and** a Token: a Level 10 Synchro with no Normal Summon.
Banish a Swordsoul card or Wyrm from your GY for a Token. Best as your second play of the turn.
Going second she Summons herself, then Tributes herself to Summon Mo Ye or Taia from the Deck.

stops: **The Token lock.** While a Swordsoul Token is on the field you can only Special Summon Synchro Monsters from the Extra Deck. Use the Token before making a Link or TY-PHON.
**Mo Ye and Longyuan need a second card.** Mo Ye must reveal a Swordsoul card or Wyrm, and Longyuan must discard one. A hand of one Swordsoul and four hand traps makes only a 1700 ATK monster.
**Tenyi need no Effect Monsters on your field** to Summon themselves, so they go first. Their second effects need a **non-Effect** monster: a Token or Monk of the Tenyi.

engines.t: Each one makes a Token in a different way and gives a different bonus when sent to the GY as Synchro Material. Each effect is once per turn.

key.t: Level 4. Summoned: reveal a Swordsoul card or Wyrm for a Token. As material: draw 1.
Level 4. Banish a Swordsoul card or Wyrm from your GY for a Token. As material: send a Swordsoul card or Wyrm from your Deck to the GY.
Level 6. Discard a Swordsoul card or Wyrm to Summon it and a Token. As material: 1200 damage.
Spell. Adds a Swordsoul monster (or any Wyrm if you control a Synchro). If banished: change a Wyrm's Level by 1.
Trap. Destroy 1 of your Wyrms and 2 of their cards. If banished: Special Summon a Token.
Level 4 Tuner. Quick Effect: Tribute her to Summon a Swordsoul monster from hand or Deck.

engines.t: Wyrms that Special Summon themselves from hand while you control no Effect Monsters. Later, with a Token or Monk on the field, they can be banished from your hand or GY for a second effect.

key.t: Level 7. Banish it: return 1 card they control to the hand.
Level 7. Banish it: Special Summon a Tenyi from your Deck (Wyrms only for the rest of the turn).
Level 1 Tuner. Banish it: add 1 of your banished Wyrms to your hand.
Level 4 Tuner. Summons itself if you control a Wyrm. Used for a Wyrm Synchro, it Summons Monk of the Tenyi.
Link-1 with no effect. Its job is to be the non-Effect Monster that turns the Tenyi effects on.

engines.t: Level 8 = Token + a Level 4. Level 10 = Token + Longyuan. Level 11 = Token + a Level 7 Tenyi.

key.t: Level 8. Synchro Summoned: add or banish a Swordsoul card from your Deck. Quick Effect: banish a Swordsoul card or Wyrm from hand or GY to negate a monster. One effect per turn.
Level 10. Whenever a card is banished: banish 1 card from their field and 1 from their GY. Gains ATK for each banished card.
Level 10. Banishes a monster they Special Summon, and a Spell/Trap they activate, dealing 1200 damage each time.

key.c: Baxia, Brightness of the Yang Zing
key.t: Level 8. Synchro Summoned: shuffle cards on the field into the Deck, 1 per Attribute among the Wyrms used.
Level 8. Quick Effect: when they activate a monster effect, banish that monster.
Level 11. Unaffected by their activated effects while your LP are equal to or lower than theirs. Pay 1000 LP to banish 1 of your monsters and 1 of their cards.

cards: Baxia, Brightness of the Yang Zing

engines.t: **Evenly Matched** ×2 makes them banish their field down to your card count. **Harpie's Feather Duster** clears Spells and Traps. Ash Blossom ×3, Infinite Impermanence ×3, Ghost Ogre ×2, Nibiru and Droll interrupt. Bystial Druiswurm and Magnamhut are free Level 6 Dragons. Pot of Prosperity digs for a starter.

facts.t: **A Swordsoul Token is a Level 4 WATER Wyrm Tuner with no effect.** Because it has no effect, it turns on every Tenyi second effect.

**While a Token is on your field, you can only Special Summon Synchro Monsters from the Extra Deck.** S:P Little Knight, I:P Masquerena, Accesscode Talker, Monk and TY-PHON have to wait until the Token is used.
**Chixiao gets one effect per turn**, either the search or the negate. Search on your turn, negate on theirs: the limit resets each turn.
**Chixiao's negate banishes a card as its cost, and that triggers Chengying.** One activation negates a monster and banishes a card from their field and their GY.
**Incredible Ecclesia never returns to your hand here.** That effect needs a Fusion Monster sent to your GY and the deck has none. Her Tribute effect only finds Swordsoul monsters.
**Evenly Matched from your hand needs you to control no cards.** Enter the Battle Phase with an empty field, then play your turn in Main Phase 2.
**Monk of the Tenyi, Summoned by Suruya, can't be used as Link Material**, and it costs you 1000 LP.

str: Nine Swordsoul monsters plus three Emergence, so the deck almost always has a Token.
Chixiao and Chengying together negate and banish from a single activation.
Evenly Matched, Feather Duster, Nibiru and 8 other hand traps for going second.
Bonuses on Synchro Material (draw, send, 1200 damage) keep the hand full.
weak: The Token lock delays Link and Xyz plays.
Mo Ye and Longyuan each need another Swordsoul card or Wyrm in hand.
Your own Effect Monsters switch off the Tenyi self-Summons.
Only 5 Spells, so few ways to recover from a negated Normal Summon.

combos.h: Line A — Mo Ye + Longyuan into Chixiao and Chengying
combos.about: The standard two-card play. Mo Ye reveals Longyuan to get a Token, and the two make Chixiao (4 + 4 = 8). Chixiao searches Taia, which becomes Longyuan's discard. Longyuan brings its own Token and they make a Level 10 (4 + 6). You draw a card and deal 1200 damage along the way.

steps.t: **Normal Summon Mo Ye.** Reveal Longyuan in your hand to Special Summon a **Swordsoul Token** (Level 4 Tuner).
**Synchro Summon Chixiao** (Level 8) using the Token + Mo Ye. Mo Ye, as material, draws you 1 card.
Chixiao was Synchro Summoned: **add Swordsoul of Taia** from your Deck.
Longyuan's effect: discard Taia to **Special Summon Longyuan** and a second Token.
**Synchro Summon Chengying** (Level 10) using the Token + Longyuan. Longyuan, as material, deals 1200 damage.

end.t: Chixiao + Chengying. On their turn Chixiao banishes Mo Ye or Taia from your GY to negate a monster's effects, and that banish triggers Chengying: banish 1 card from their field and 1 from their GY. If an effect would destroy Chengying, banish a card from your GY instead.

rules: Chixiao gets one effect per turn. It searched on your turn, so its negate is ready on their turn.
Against Spell/Trap-heavy decks make **Qixing Longyuan** as your Level 10 instead: it banishes a Spell/Trap they activate and a monster they Special Summon.
If Chixiao's search is negated, Longyuan can discard any other Swordsoul card or Wyrm.

combos.h: Line B — Tenyi start into Psychic End Punisher
combos.about: Tenyi Spirits Summon themselves while you control no Effect Monsters, so Vishuda comes first. Mo Ye's Token + Vishuda (4 + 7) makes Psychic End Punisher. Suruya + Mo Ye makes Chixiao, and Suruya then Summons Monk of the Tenyi at a cost of 1000 LP. That cost is useful: Psychic End Punisher is protected while your LP are lower.

steps.t: You control no Effect Monsters: **Special Summon Vishuda** from your hand.
**Normal Summon Mo Ye.** Reveal Suruya (a Wyrm) to Special Summon a Swordsoul Token.
You control a Wyrm: **Special Summon Suruya** (Level 4 Tuner) from your hand.
**Synchro Summon Psychic End Punisher** (Level 11) using the Token + Vishuda (7).
**Synchro Summon Chixiao** (Level 8) using Suruya (Tuner) + Mo Ye. Mo Ye draws 1 and Chixiao adds a Swordsoul card.
Suruya was material for a Wyrm Synchro: **Special Summon Monk of the Tenyi** from your Extra Deck. You lose 1000 LP.

end.t: Psychic End Punisher (3500 ATK) + Chixiao + Monk. Your LP are lower than theirs, so Psychic End Punisher is unaffected by their activated effects. Chixiao negates a monster on their turn. Monk has no effect, so next turn you can banish Vishuda from your GY to return 1 of their cards to the hand.

rules: Use the Token in step 4 before Monk arrives. While a Token is on the field only Synchros can come from the Extra Deck, and Monk is a Link.
Psychic End Punisher's protection only applies while your LP are equal to or lower than theirs.
Each Tenyi's Summon and its banish effect are once per turn.

combos.h: Line C — Ecclesia going second
combos.about: When they control more monsters than you, Incredible Ecclesia Summons herself from your hand. She Tributes herself to bring Mo Ye from the Deck, so your Normal Summon is still free. Chixiao negates their best monster, then Taia and a second Token make Baxia, which shuffles two of their cards into the Deck.

steps.t: **Activate Harpie's Feather Duster**: destroy all their Spells and Traps.
They control more monsters: **Special Summon Incredible Ecclesia** from your hand.
Ecclesia's Quick Effect: Tribute her to **Special Summon Mo Ye from your Deck**. Mo Ye reveals Emergence for a Token.
**Synchro Summon Chixiao** using the Token + Mo Ye. Mo Ye draws 1. Don't use Chixiao's search.
Chixiao's Quick Effect: banish Mo Ye from your GY to **negate 1 of their Effect Monsters**.
Activate Emergence: **add Taia** and Normal Summon it. Taia banishes Emergence from your GY for a Token.
**Synchro Summon Baxia** (Level 8) using the Token (WATER) + Taia (WIND): two Attributes, so shuffle 2 of their cards into the Deck.
cards: Baxia, Brightness of the Yang Zing

end.t: Chixiao (2800) + Baxia (2300) facing a field with no Spells or Traps, its best monster negated and two more cards shuffled away. Attack with both.
cards: Baxia, Brightness of the Yang Zing

rules: Skip Chixiao's search here: it can only use one effect per turn and you need the negate now.
Baxia counts the Attributes of the **Wyrms** used. Token (WATER) + Taia (WIND) is two. Token + Mo Ye (both WATER) is one.
Shuffling into the Deck doesn't destroy or send to the GY, so most protection doesn't stop it.

swordsoul-tenyi.arch: Wyrm Synchro (Swordsoul) with the Tenyi non-Effect sub-engine, Incredible Ecclesia as an extra Swordsoul extender, two Bystials, and a heavy going-second suite (Evenly Matched ×2, Harpie's Feather Duster, Nibiru, 3 Ash, 3 Impermanence, 2 Ghost Ogre).

tenpai-wyrm.pitch: Three small engines that share one Extra Deck. **Swordsoul** builds a Wyrm Synchro board in the Main Phase. **Tenpai Dragons** Synchro Summon in the middle of the Battle Phase and win in one turn. **Sky Striker** Spells negate and steal monsters while your Main Monster Zones are empty.

plan.first: Use the Swordsoul half: **Qixing Longyuan** and **Chixiao**, with Swordsoul Blackout or Infinite Impermanence Set. Qixing banishes what they Summon and activate, and Chixiao negates a monster.
plan.second: Use the Tenpai half. Lightning Storm and Widow Anchor clear the way, then Paidra attacks and the Tenpai Dragons Synchro during the Battle Phase into **Transcendent Dragion**, which stops them activating anything.
plan.win: Four attacks in one Battle Phase: Paidra, Transcendent Dragion, Paidra again and Bident Dragion, for 9000 damage with no responses allowed.

open.t: The Tenpai starter. Normal Summon it to add Sangen Summoning, which finds Chundra.
The Swordsoul starter. Reveal a Swordsoul card or Wyrm for a Token, and draw when it is used as material.
Discard a Swordsoul card or Wyrm to Summon it and a Token: a Level 10 Synchro with no Normal Summon.
Adds any Swordsoul monster.
With no monsters in your Main Monster Zones: adds Widow Anchor or Hornet Drones.

stops: **One Normal Summon, three engines.** Paidra and Mo Ye both want it. Going first choose Mo Ye; going second choose Paidra. Longyuan and the Tenyi don't need it.
**Sky Striker Spells need empty Main Monster Zones.** Play them before you Summon anything. A Link in the Extra Monster Zone doesn't count against them.
**The locks don't mix.** A Swordsoul Token allows only Synchros from the Extra Deck. Ashuna's effect allows only Wyrms. Bident Dragion allows only Dragons. Finish one engine before starting another.

engines.t: FIRE Dragons that Synchro Summon during the **Battle Phase** as a Quick Effect. This is the going-second half and the way the deck wins.

key.t: Level 3. Summoned: add or Set a Sangen Spell/Trap. You take no battle damage from your FIRE Dragons' battles.
Level 4 Tuner. Summons itself if you control a FIRE Dragon. When a monster battles: Special Summon a Level 4 or lower FIRE Dragon from the Deck.
Level 3. Summoned, or when a monster battles: revive a Level 4 or lower FIRE Dragon. Your FIRE Dragons can't be destroyed by battle.
Field Spell. Adds a Tenpai Dragon, then you discard 1. In your Main Phase 1 your FIRE Dragons are unaffected by their activated effects.
Quick-Play. Adds a FIRE Dragon or Summons one from hand. In the Battle Phase it does both.
Level 7 Synchro **Tuner**. Revives a FIRE Dragon. Returns from the GY once per Duel after 3 attacks.
Level 10. Changes all monsters to Attack Position, and they can't activate cards or effects during the Battle Phase.
Level 10. Destroy up to 2 of your other cards: it gains an extra attack for each.

engines.t: Each Swordsoul monster makes a Level 4 Tuner Token. Token + monster is a Level 8 or 10 Wyrm Synchro, and the monster gives a bonus as material. This is the going-first half.

key.t: Summoned: reveal a Swordsoul card or Wyrm for a Token. As material: draw 1.
Banish a Swordsoul card or Wyrm from your GY for a Token. As material: send one from Deck to GY.
Level 6. Discard a Swordsoul card or Wyrm to Summon it and a Token. As material: 1200 damage.
Level 10. Banishes a monster they Special Summon and a Spell/Trap they activate, with 1200 damage each. Draws when you Synchro Summon another Wyrm.
Level 8. Adds a Swordsoul card, or (Quick Effect) negates a monster. One effect per turn.
Trap. Destroy 1 of your Wyrms and 2 of their cards.

engines.t: Spells that only work while you control no monsters in your **Main** Monster Zones. They get stronger once 3 Spells are in your GY. The Ace Links sit in the Extra Monster Zone, so they don't switch the Spells off.

key.t: Adds a Sky Striker card. With 3+ Spells in the GY, also draws 1.
Quick-Play. Negates an Effect Monster. With 3+ Spells in the GY, also takes control of it until the End Phase.
Quick-Play. Special Summons a Sky Striker Ace Token.
Link-1 made from the Token. Returns a Sky Striker Spell from your GY to your hand.
Link-2 from 2 Effect Monsters. Sends a Sky Striker card from Deck to GY. Use a stolen monster as its material.
Link-2 from 2 Aces. Adds a Sky Striker Spell from Deck or GY.

engines.t: **Vishuda** ×2, **Ashuna** ×2 and **Adhara** Summon themselves while you control no Effect Monsters, giving Level 7 and Level 1 bodies for Synchros. Ash Blossom ×3, Infinite Impermanence ×3, Effect Veiler, Droll and Nibiru are the hand traps. **Lightning Storm** clears a field. Black Rose Dragon and Kuibelt are Level 7 Synchros that destroy cards.

facts.t: **Tenpai Dragons Synchro Summon during the Battle Phase**, each once per turn, using themselves as material. Bident Dragion is a Synchro Tuner, so it continues the climb to Level 10.
**While Transcendent Dragion is on the field, your opponent can't activate cards or effects in the Battle Phase.** Get to it as early in the Battle Phase as you can.
**Sky Striker Spells check your Main Monster Zones only.** Kagari, Camellia and Zero in the Extra Monster Zone keep them usable.
**The deck runs no Raye or Roze.** Kagari is made from the Sky Striker Ace Token that Hornet Drones Summons. Zero's Tribute effect has nothing to Summon.
**Ashuna's banish effect locks you to Wyrm Special Summons** for the turn. The Tenpai Dragons are Dragons, so don't use it on a Tenpai turn.
**A Swordsoul Token locks your Extra Deck to Synchros** while it is on the field. Sky Striker Links and Monk of the Tenyi wait until it is gone.
**Sangen Summoning's search makes you discard a card.** Keep a spare in hand, ideally a Wyrm or Swordsoul card that Taia can banish from the GY later.

str: Three engines, so one hand trap rarely stops the whole turn.
Paidra is a one-card start to a Battle Phase the opponent can't respond in.
Qixing Longyuan and Chixiao give a real going-first board.
Widow Anchor and Lightning Storm work from an empty field.
weak: The engines compete for the Normal Summon and lock each other out.
Chundra, Sangen Summoning, Sangen Kaimen and Hornet Drones are all Limited to 1.
Sky Striker Spells are dead once you have Main Monster Zone monsters.
The Tenpai half does nothing going first, when there is no Battle Phase.

combos.h: Line A — Swordsoul into Qixing Longyuan (going first)
combos.about: The going-first board. Mo Ye and Longyuan each bring a Token. Longyuan + Token makes Qixing Longyuan first, so that when Mo Ye + Token then makes Chixiao, Qixing draws you a card for Synchro Summoning another Wyrm. You end with two draws and 1200 damage dealt.

steps.t: **Normal Summon Mo Ye.** Reveal Longyuan to Special Summon a **Swordsoul Token** (Level 4 Tuner).
Longyuan's effect: discard Taia to **Special Summon Longyuan** and a second Token.
**Synchro Summon Qixing Longyuan** (Level 10) using a Token + Longyuan. Longyuan, as material, deals 1200 damage.
**Synchro Summon Chixiao** (Level 8) using the other Token + Mo Ye. Mo Ye draws 1, and Qixing draws 1.
Chixiao was Synchro Summoned: **add Swordsoul Blackout** from your Deck and Set it.

end.t: Qixing Longyuan + Chixiao + a Set Blackout. When they Special Summon, Qixing banishes that monster for 1200 damage. When they activate a Spell or Trap, it banishes that card for another 1200. Chixiao negates a monster by banishing Taia or Mo Ye from your GY.

rules: Chixiao gets one effect per turn: it searched on your turn, so the negate is ready on theirs.
While a Token is on the field you can only Special Summon Synchros from the Extra Deck.
Blackout destroys one of your own Wyrms along with 2 of their cards. Use it when a Synchro is about to be removed anyway.

combos.h: Line B — Tenpai Battle Phase win (going second)
combos.about: The Tenpai Dragons do their work during the Battle Phase. Paidra finds the Field Spell, which finds Chundra. When Paidra attacks, Chundra brings Fadra from the Deck. Chundra + Paidra then Synchro into Bident Dragion, and Bident + Fadra into Transcendent Dragion. From that point they can't activate anything.

steps.t: **Normal Summon Paidra.** It adds Sangen Summoning from your Deck.
Activate Sangen Summoning. Its effect **adds Chundra**, then you discard 1 card (here Effect Veiler).
You control a FIRE Dragon: **Special Summon Chundra** from your hand.
Battle Phase: **Paidra attacks.** At the start of the Damage Step, Chundra Special Summons Fadra from your Deck.
Chundra's Quick Effect: **Synchro Summon Bident Dragion** (Level 7) using Chundra (4, Tuner) + Paidra (3).
Bident was Synchro Summoned: **Special Summon Paidra** from your GY. Only Dragons can be Special Summoned from now on.
Fadra's Quick Effect: **Synchro Summon Transcendent Dragion** (Level 10) using Bident (7, Tuner) + Fadra (3).
Transcendent changes all monsters to Attack Position. **Attack with Transcendent (3000) and Paidra (1700).** They can't respond.
3 attacks have been declared: **Special Summon Bident from your GY**, destroy 1 Spell/Trap, and attack with it (2600).

end.t: Four attacks in one Battle Phase for 1700 + 3000 + 1700 + 2600 = 9000 damage if they are direct. Their monsters are forced into Attack Position, and nothing can be activated against you once Transcendent Dragion is out.

rules: Clear their monsters first with Lightning Storm or Widow Anchor so the attacks are direct.
Paidra means you take no battle damage from your FIRE Dragons' battles, so attacking into a bigger monster to start the chain is safe.
Bident's return from the GY is once per Duel.

combos.h: Line C — Sky Striker first (going second)
combos.about: Sky Striker Spells need your Main Monster Zones empty, so they are the first thing you play. Hornet Drones makes a Token, the Token becomes Kagari in the Extra Monster Zone, and Kagari returns Engage to your hand. With 3 Spells in the GY, Widow Anchor takes their best monster, and you Link it away.

steps.t: You control no face-up cards: **activate Lightning Storm** and destroy all their Spells and Traps.
Activate Engage!: **add Hornet Drones** from your Deck.
Activate Hornet Drones: **Special Summon a Sky Striker Ace Token**.
**Link Summon Kagari** to the Extra Monster Zone using the Token. Kagari returns Engage! from your GY to your hand.
Your Main Monster Zones are empty again: activate Engage! and **add your second Widow Anchor**.
Activate Widow Anchor with 3 Spells in your GY: **negate their best Effect Monster and take control of it**.
**Link Summon Camellia** using the stolen monster + Kagari. Their monster is gone for good.

end.t: Camellia in the Extra Monster Zone, their backrow destroyed and their best monster used as Link Material. You still hold a Widow Anchor and your Normal Summon: Summon Paidra and go to Line B.

rules: Count the Spells in your GY. Widow Anchor only takes control with 3 or more there when it resolves.
Kagari and Camellia can each be Special Summoned once per turn.
Lightning Storm needs you to control no face-up cards, so it comes before everything else.

tenpai-wyrm.arch: Three-engine Synchro/Link hybrid. Swordsoul Tokens + Tenyi build Wyrm Synchros on the Main Phase; the Tenpai Dragon/Sangen package Synchro Summons FIRE Dragons mid-Battle Phase for an OTK; the Sky Striker Spell package provides empty-field interaction and Ace Links.

synchron.pitch: The classic Synchro deck. **Junk Synchron** and a Level 2 monster make **Junk Speeder**, and Junk Speeder Summons five Synchron Tuners of different Levels from the Deck at once. From that field you add Levels together to build Stardust Dragons, Clear Wing and **Satellite Warrior**.

plan.first: Get to Junk Speeder, then make **Clear Wing Synchro Dragon** and **Accel Synchro Stardust Dragon**. On their turn Clear Wing negates a Level 5+ monster, and Accel turns into Stardust Dragon and then Satellite Warrior, destroying up to 3 cards.
plan.second: Synchro Emergency can build the Speeder field during **their** turn. On yours, Satellite Warrior destroys one card for each Synchro Monster in your GY. Effect Veiler ×3 and Infinite Impermanence ×3 cover the Normal Summon.
plan.win: Satellite Warrior gains 1000 ATK for each card it destroys (4500 or more) and attacks with the Stardust Dragons after the field is cleared.

open.t: The one-card combo. Adds Junk Synchron and Full-Speed Warrior, and the discard puts Full-Speed Warrior where Junk Synchron needs it.
Discard it with **any Tuner** (hand traps count) to add Junk Synchron. It is then the Level 2 in the GY that Junk Synchron revives.
Normal Summon it to revive a Level 2 or lower monster from the GY. 3 + 2 = Junk Speeder.
Adds Junk Synchron or any Synchron Tuner.
Adds Junk Synchron when Summoned, and is a Level 2 for Junk Speeder.

stops: **Junk Synchron needs a Level 2 or lower monster already in your GY.** Fellowship's discard and Junk Converter's cost both arrange that. A bare Junk Synchron does nothing.
**Ash Blossom on Junk Speeder** stops all five Tuners. If you hold Stardust Synchron or Assault Synchron, keep one back so you can still make a Level 7 or 8.

**Synchro-only locks.** Junk Speeder, Stardust Synchron, Wheel, Assault and Junk Meister lock your Extra Deck to Synchros for the turn, so Super Polymerization belongs on a different turn or on theirs.

engines.t: Everything here exists to put Junk Synchron on the field with a Level 2 in the GY, because that pair is Junk Speeder.

key.t: Adds Junk Synchron + a monster that mentions Junk Warrior or Stardust Dragon, then you discard 1. From the GY: lower a Synchro's Level by 1 and gain a Normal Summon for a Synchron.
Level 3 Tuner. Normal Summoned: revive a Level 2 or lower monster (effects negated).
Level 2. Discard it and a Tuner to add a Synchron. Used as Synchro Material: revive a Tuner from the GY.
Level 2. Summoned: add Junk Synchron or a Spell/Trap that mentions Junk Warrior (Synchro Fellowship).
Spell. Adds a Synchron Tuner, then sends the top card of your Deck to the GY.
Level 4. Summons itself by revealing a Warrior or Stardust Synchro in your Extra Deck, then adds a Junk card.

engines.t: Junk Speeder Summons one of each Level from the Deck. Knowing what each does tells you which to use first.

key.t: Level 1. Stands in for any Synchron Tuner, and can be banished from field or GY to save a Warrior Synchro.
Level 2. From the GY: when your Dragon Synchro is Tributed or banished, banish Assault to bring that Synchro back.
Level 4. Summoned: add a Spell/Trap that mentions Stardust Dragon (Synchro Fellowship).
Level 5. Can be treated as a **non-Tuner**, so it is the second non-Tuner you need. Also gives an extra Normal Summon.
Level 3. Can be used as material from your hand for a Level 7 or 8 Dragon Synchro.

engines.t: Add the Levels: Tuner + non-Tuner. Junk Speeder and Wheel Synchron are your two Level 5 non-Tuners, so 2 + 5 is Clear Wing and 3 + 5 is a Stardust.

key.t: Level 5. Summons as many Synchron Tuners with different Levels as possible from your Deck.
Level 7. Negates and destroys a Level 5+ monster's effect, and effects that target a Level 5+ monster.
Level 8. Revives a Level 2 or lower Tuner. Quick Effect: Tribute it to Summon Stardust Dragon, then immediately Synchro Summon again.
Level 8. Tribute it to negate and destroy an effect that would destroy a card. It returns in the End Phase.
Level 10, made with a Synchro as the non-Tuner. Destroys their cards up to the number of Synchros in your GY and gains 1000 ATK for each.
Level 8. Tribute it to negate a card they chain to your effect.
Level 6. Draws 1 when Synchro Summoned, and attacks all their Special Summoned monsters.
Level 5. Draws 1 every time a monster is Synchro Summoned.

engines.t: Effect Veiler ×3, Ash Blossom ×3 and Ghost Ogre are hand traps **and** Tuners, so they also pay for Junk Converter. Infinite Impermanence ×3, Droll and Nibiru complete the set. **Synchro Emergency** ×3 Summons from hand and Deck and can Synchro on their turn. **Super Polymerization** ×2 makes Garura or Mudragon.

facts.t: **Junk Speeder needs a "Synchron" Tuner as its Tuner**, and you need empty Main Monster Zones for what it Summons. Synchro Summon it to the Extra Monster Zone.
**Junk Synchron negates the effects of the monster it revives, but only on the field.** Junk Converter still revives a Tuner when it is sent to the GY as Synchro Material.
**Junk Converter needs a Tuner in your hand to discard.** The deck runs 16: nine Synchrons, Ash Blossom ×3, Effect Veiler ×3 and Ghost Ogre.
**Wheel Synchron can be treated as a non-Tuner** when used as Synchro Material. With another Tuner it makes a Synchro by itself.
**Satellite Warrior's non-Tuner material must be a Synchro Monster**, and it counts Synchro Monsters in your GY when it is Summoned. Make it last.
**Synchro Emergency locks your Extra Deck to Synchros until the end of the next turn.** That covers your own turn if you use it on theirs.
**Junk Warrior itself is not in the Extra Deck.** Cards that say "mentions Junk Warrior" still find Full-Speed Warrior, Scrap Synchron and Synchro Fellowship.

str: Synchro Fellowship is a one-card route to Junk Speeder and five Tuners.
Seven hand traps are Tuners, so they double as combo pieces.
Clear Wing, Stardust Dragon and Accel give negation on the opponent's turn.
Satellite Warrior breaks boards and Synchro Emergency lets you start on their turn.
weak: Ash Blossom on Fellowship, Tuning or Junk Speeder cuts the turn short.
Junk Synchron is useless without a Level 2 in the GY.
The Synchro-only locks keep Super Polymerization for another turn.
The lines are long: one mistake with Levels or zones costs the board.

combos.h: Line A — Fellowship into Junk Speeder
combos.about: A full board from one Spell. Fellowship finds Junk Synchron and a Level 2 and puts the Level 2 in the GY. Junk Synchron revives it and they make Junk Speeder, which Summons five Tuners. Assault + Speeder is Clear Wing. Junk Synchron + Wheel is Accel Synchro Stardust Dragon, which acts on their turn.

steps.t: Activate Synchro Fellowship: **add Junk Synchron and Full-Speed Warrior**, then discard Full-Speed Warrior.
**Normal Summon Junk Synchron.** It Special Summons Full-Speed Warrior from your GY.
**Synchro Summon Junk Speeder** (Level 5) to the Extra Monster Zone using Junk Synchron (3) + Full-Speed Warrior (2).
Junk Speeder's effect: **Special Summon 5 Tuners from your Deck**: Scrap (Level 1), Assault (2), Junk (3), Stardust (4) and Wheel Synchron (5).
Stardust Synchron was Summoned: **add your second Synchro Fellowship** for next turn.
**Synchro Summon Clear Wing** (Level 7) using Assault (2, Tuner) + Junk Speeder (5).
**Synchro Summon Accel Synchro Stardust Dragon** (Level 8) using Junk Synchron (3) + Wheel (5, as a non-Tuner). It revives Assault.
Their Main Phase: Tribute Accel to **Special Summon Stardust Dragon** from your Extra Deck, then Synchro Summon immediately.
That Synchro Summon: **Satellite Warrior** (Level 10) using Assault (2) + Stardust Dragon (8). Destroy up to 3 of their cards.

end.t: End your turn on Clear Wing + Accel with Assault, Scrap and Stardust Synchron beside them. Clear Wing negates a Level 5+ monster's effect. Accel then becomes Satellite Warrior in the middle of their turn: 3 Synchros are in your GY, so it destroys 3 cards, reaches 5500 ATK and is unaffected by their effects that turn.

rules: Count Levels before each Synchro. The only non-Tuners are Junk Speeder and Wheel Synchron, so each can pay for one Synchro.
If you would rather keep Stardust Dragon's negate, skip Accel's revive in step 7. With Assault in the GY, banish it when Accel is Tributed and Accel comes back.
You can only activate 1 Synchro Fellowship per turn.

combos.h: Line B — Junk Converter + any Tuner
combos.about: The two-card version, and the reason hand traps are never dead here. Junk Converter discards itself with any Tuner to find Junk Synchron. Junk Synchron revives Converter, and they make Junk Speeder. Converter, used as material, then brings the discarded Tuner back too.

steps.t: Junk Converter's effect: discard it and Effect Veiler (a Tuner) to **add Junk Synchron**.
**Normal Summon Junk Synchron.** It Special Summons Junk Converter (Level 2) from your GY.
**Synchro Summon Junk Speeder** to the Extra Monster Zone using Junk Synchron + Junk Converter.
Junk Converter was used as Synchro Material: **Special Summon Effect Veiler** from your GY in Defense Position.
Junk Speeder's effect: **Special Summon Assault, Junk, Stardust and Wheel Synchron** from your Deck (4 zones are free).
Continue from Line A step 5: **Clear Wing**, then **Accel Synchro Stardust Dragon**.

end.t: The Line A board with Effect Veiler (a Level 1 Tuner) in Scrap Synchron's place: Clear Wing + Accel + three Tuners.

rules: Any Tuner pays for Junk Converter: Ash Blossom, Effect Veiler, Ghost Ogre or a Synchron you don't need.
The Tuner that Converter revives can't activate its effects this turn, but it is a body for a Synchro.
Each Junk Converter effect is once per turn.

combos.h: Line C — Satellite Warrior (going second)
combos.about: The board breaker. Satellite Warrior destroys one card for every Synchro Monster in your GY, so you make two cheap Synchros first and use one as its material. Stardust Charge Warrior draws a card on the way, and Accel stays on the field as a second attacker.

steps.t: Play Line A steps 1–5: **Junk Speeder + five Tuners** (Scrap, Assault, Junk, Stardust, Wheel).
**Synchro Summon Stardust Charge Warrior** (Level 6) using Scrap (1) + Junk Speeder (5). Draw 1.
**Synchro Summon Accel Synchro Stardust Dragon** (Level 8) using Junk Synchron (3) + Wheel (5, as a non-Tuner). It revives Scrap.
**Synchro Summon Satellite Warrior** (Level 10) using Stardust Synchron (4) + Charge Warrior (6).
Satellite Warrior's effect: Junk Speeder and Charge Warrior are in your GY, so **destroy 2 of their cards**. It gains 2000 ATK.
**Attack with Satellite Warrior (4500) and Accel (2500).**

end.t: Two of their cards destroyed, then 7000 damage from Satellite Warrior and Accel. If Satellite Warrior is destroyed later, it revives up to 3 Warrior, Synchron or Stardust Synchros from your GY.

rules: **Synchro Emergency** can set this up on their turn: Summon a monster from your hand and Junk Synchron from the Deck, then banish Emergency from the GY to Synchro Summon Junk Speeder.
More Synchros in the GY means more destroys. A third cheap Synchro before Satellite Warrior makes it 3.
Assault and Scrap are still on the field as Tuners for your next turn.

synchron.arch: Synchron/Stardust Synchro combo. Junk Converter turns any Tuner into Junk Synchron; Satellite Warrior is the going-second board breaker.

ignister.pitch: A Cyberse Link deck where every small monster fetches the next one. **Achichi** finds Pikari, Pikari finds a Spell, the Spell finds Backup, Backup finds Wizard. Five monsters later you Link them into 2300 ATK bosses, and **Allied Code Talker** or **Accesscode Talker** finishes the turn.

plan.first: End on **Allied Code Talker @Ignister** with Transcode Talker and Wind Pegasus beside it. Allied negates and banishes one card they activate, and it can't be targeted while linked with Transcode.
plan.second: Effect Veiler, Infinite Impermanence and Nibiru slow them down. **Ra - Sphere Mode** removes three of their monsters as a Normal Summon, then **Accesscode Talker** destroys two more cards with no response.
plan.win: Accesscode Talker at 5300 ATK, or Firewall Dragon Darkfluid attacking several times. Almost every boss has exactly 2300 ATK, which Allied Code Talker revives all at once.

open.t: The best Normal Summon: adds any Level 4 or lower @Ignister, usually Pikari.
Send 1 card from your hand to add Achichi or any Level 4 or lower Cyberse.
Reveal a 2300 ATK Cyberse in your Extra Deck to add an @Ignister of the same Attribute. Heatsoul (FIRE) finds Achichi.
Field Spell. With empty Main Monster Zones it Special Summons a Level 4 or lower @Ignister from your hand, saving your Normal Summon.
Summons itself and a DARK Cyberse from your GY once a Link Monster is out.

stops: **A negated first search.** If Achichi is negated you have an 800 ATK monster. Ignister A.I.Land or Cynet Mining in hand gives a second start.

**A.I. Meet You's price.** You must Special Summon the monster you revealed this turn, or take 2300 damage in the End Phase. After it resolves, only Cyberse monster effects can be activated, so your hand traps are off for the turn.
**Cyberse-only locks.** A.I.Land, Wizard, Transcode and A.I.dle Reborn stop non-Cyberse Special Summons. The whole Extra Deck is Cyberse, so this only matters for what you Normal Summon.

engines.t: Each of these replaces itself with another card. Lined up in order, one Normal Summon becomes five monsters.

key.t: Level 2 FIRE. Summoned: add a Level 4 or lower @Ignister.
Level 4 LIGHT. Summoned: add an A.I. Spell/Trap (A.I. Meet You, A.I.dle Reborn or FA.I.ghting Spirit).
Level 3 DARK Tuner. Summons itself if you control an Extra Deck Cyberse. Adds a DARK Cyberse, then you discard 1.
Level 4 DARK. Summoned: return an @Ignister from GY to hand. Used as Link Material: return an A.I. Spell/Trap.
Level 3 WIND Tuner. Summoned: send an @Ignister from Deck to GY.
Spell. Adds an @Ignister matching the Attribute of a 2300 ATK Cyberse you reveal.
Field Spell. Special Summons a Level 4 or lower @Ignister from hand. From the GY it can Set itself again.
Spell. Send 1 card from hand: add a Level 4 or lower Cyberse.

engines.t: Extra bodies that Summon themselves once the engine is running.

key.t: Level 4. With an Extra Deck Cyberse out: Summon it from hand together with a DARK Cyberse from your GY.
Level 1. Summons itself if you control an @Ignister. Tribute a Cyberse to add a Level 5+ @Ignister (Linkslayer).
Level 1. Summons itself if you control an @Ignister.
Level 5. Can be used as Link Material **from your hand** for an @Ignister Link. Then discard 1 to destroy a Spell/Trap.
Quick-Play. Special Summons an @Ignister from your GY.
Spell. Special Summons an @Ignister from your GY, and protects 2300+ ATK @Ignisters from destruction.

engines.t: Dark Infant starts every line. The Link-3s are steps on the way, and the Link-4 to Link-6 monsters are where you stop.

key.t: Link-1 from any @Ignister. Link Summoned: add Ignister A.I.Land.
Link-3. Revives a Link-3 or lower Cyberse Link from your GY. Linked monsters gain 500 ATK and can't be targeted.
Link-5. Link Summoned: revive every 2300 ATK Cyberse it can point to. Quick Effect: Tribute a Link it points to, negate and banish.
Link-4. Gains 1000 ATK per Link Rating of a material, and banishes Links to destroy cards. They can't respond.
Link-3 from 3 different names. Revives Level 4 or lower @Ignisters to the zones it points to.
Level 7 Synchro. Destroys their Spells/Traps, one per @Ignister you control.
Link-6 from 3+ Attributes. Unaffected by other cards' effects. 1000 ATK per material.

key.c: Firewall Dragon Darkfluid - Neo Tempest Terahertz
key.t: Link-5. Gains 2500 ATK and an Attribute, attacks once per Attribute, and negates their monster effects in the Battle Phase.

cards: Firewall Dragon Darkfluid - Neo Tempest Terahertz

engines.t: Effect Veiler ×3, Ash Blossom ×3, Nibiru ×2, Infinite Impermanence ×2, Ghost Belle and Droll. **The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode** is Normal Summoned by Tributing 3 of **their** monsters. Light Dragon, Cyberse Quantum Dragon, Heatsoul and Firewall eXceed Dragon are the other Extra Deck options.
cards: The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode

facts.t: **A.I. Meet You by Attribute:** reveal Heatsoul (FIRE) for Achichi, Light Dragon (LIGHT) for Pikari, Wind Pegasus (WIND) for Bururu, Transcode (EARTH) for Doshin, and Allied, Accesscode or Dark Templar (DARK) for Backup, Wizard, Doyon or Linkslayer.
**You must then Special Summon the monster you revealed**, or one with the same name, this turn. Otherwise you take 2300 damage in the End Phase. Reveal the boss you are going to make.
**Ignister A.I.Land needs your Main Monster Zones empty.** Dark Infant in the Extra Monster Zone doesn't count, which is why it is Link Summoned first.
**Allied Code Talker only revives monsters with exactly 2300 ATK**, and only to zones it points to. In the Extra Monster Zone that is the three zones below it.
**Ra - Sphere Mode can't be Special Summoned.** It uses your Normal Summon, goes to their field, can't attack, and can't be targeted by you. Control returns to you at the end of the next turn.
cards: The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode

facts.t: **Link Spider needs a Normal Monster**, and the deck has none. It is there for the Token that their Nibiru leaves on your field.
**Nothing to find:** Hiyari's A.I.'s Ritual, Doshin's A.I. Love Fusion and Sphere Mode's Winged Dragon of Ra are not in the deck.

str: Achichi, Cynet Mining, A.I. Meet You and A.I.Land all start the same chain.
Most cards replace themselves, so the hand stays full.
Accesscode Talker's destroys can't be responded to.
Ra - Sphere Mode removes three monsters without targeting or destroying.
weak: A.I. Meet You deals 2300 damage to you if the line is interrupted.
GY hate stops Wizard, Doyon and the revival Spells.
Going first the deck has one negate; it relies on hand traps for the rest.
The lines are long and each step is a place for Ash Blossom or Veiler.

combos.h: Line A — Achichi into Allied Code Talker (going first)
combos.about: Each monster fetches the next. Achichi becomes Dark Infant to find the Field Spell, which Summons Pikari. Pikari finds A.I. Meet You, which finds Backup, which finds Doyon and discards it. Wizard brings Doyon back. Those five become Wind Pegasus and Transcode Talker, and both go into Allied Code Talker, which revives them.

steps.t: **Normal Summon Achichi.** It adds Pikari from your Deck.
**Link Summon Dark Infant** to the Extra Monster Zone using Achichi. It adds Ignister A.I.Land.
Activate A.I.Land: **Special Summon Pikari** from your hand. Pikari adds A.I. Meet You.
Activate A.I. Meet You: reveal Allied Code Talker (DARK) in your Extra Deck and **add Backup**.
**Special Summon Backup** from your hand. It adds Doyon, then you discard Doyon.
Wizard's effect: **Special Summon Wizard** from your hand **and Doyon** from your GY. Doyon returns Achichi to your hand.
**Synchro Summon Wind Pegasus** (Level 7) using Backup (3, Tuner) + Wizard (4).
**Link Summon Transcode Talker** using Dark Infant + Pikari + Doyon. Doyon returns A.I. Meet You to your hand.
Transcode's effect: **Special Summon Dark Infant** from your GY to a zone Transcode points to.
**Link Summon Allied Code Talker** (Link-5) using Transcode + Dark Infant + Wind Pegasus.
Allied's effect: **Special Summon Transcode and Wind Pegasus** from your GY to zones it points to. Allied gains 1000 ATK.

end.t: Allied Code Talker + Transcode Talker + Wind Pegasus, with Achichi and A.I. Meet You back in hand for next turn. When they activate a card or effect, Allied Tributes Transcode to negate it and banish that card. Put Transcode directly below Allied: they are then linked to each other, gain 500 ATK and can't be targeted.

After Allied's effect you can't Special Summon again this turn, so make it last.

combos.h: Line B — Accesscode Talker finish (going second)
combos.about: The same opening, aimed at damage. Reveal Accesscode Talker for A.I. Meet You this time. Transcode Talker revives Dark Infant, and both become Accesscode at 5300 ATK. It then banishes Links from your GY to destroy a card each, and they can't respond. Wind Pegasus destroys a Spell/Trap as well.

**Synchro Summon Wind Pegasus** using Backup + Wizard. Its effect destroys 1 Spell/Trap they control.

**Attack with Accesscode (5300) and Wind Pegasus (2300).**

end.t: Three of their cards destroyed and 7600 damage on the table. Wizard in your GY can be banished to change one of their monsters' battle positions, which helps the attacks through.

Wind Pegasus destroys Spells/Traps up to the number of @Ignister monsters you control. It counts itself.
Use Ra - Sphere Mode first if they have three monsters (Line C), since it needs your Normal Summon.

Three monsters are gone without being targeted or destroyed. Your Normal Summon is spent, so A.I.Land Summons Achichi instead, and Linkslayer joins a Link Summon from your hand to destroy a Spell/Trap.
hand: The Winged Dragon of Ra - Sphere Mode

Linkslayer can only be used from the hand for the Link Summon of an **@Ignister** monster, such as Dark Templar.
A.I.Land only Summons while your Main Monster Zones are empty, so use it before anything else.

ignister.arch: @Ignister Cyberse Link combo. Small Level 1–5 @Ignisters search each other and A.I. Spells, then climb through Dark Infant / Wicckid / Transcode into Dark Templar, Allied Code Talker, Accesscode Talker, The Arrival and Firewall Darkfluid.

branded-dracotail.pitch: A Fusion deck with two engines and an Extra Deck made entirely of Fusion Monsters. **Fallen of Albaz** fuses with the opponent's own monsters. The **Dracotail** monsters fuse at Quick Effect speed, and each one used as material Sets a Spell or Trap from the Deck and often removes a card too.

plan.first: Dracotail: end on **Gulamel** and **Arthalion** with Dracotail Horn Set and Faimena in hand. Branded: end on **Mirrorjade**, which banishes a monster on their turn and brings another Albaz out in the End Phase.
plan.second: Discard a Mulcharmy first while your field is empty. Then Albaz fuses away one of their monsters, Mirrorjade banishes another, and Super Polymerization takes two more with no response.
plan.win: 3000 ATK Fusions after their board has been used as your Fusion Material. Each Fusion you lose replaces itself: Titaniklad finds Albaz, and Aluber comes back to negate.

open.t: Normal Summon it to add Branded Fusion, which fuses using monsters from your Deck.
Normal Summon it and discard 1 card to fuse it with one of their monsters. Your best going-second card.
Normal Summon it to add any other Dracotail monster.
Quick Effect: discard it to Fusion Summon a Dragon or Spellcaster Fusion using your hand and field.
Going second: discard it while you control no cards and draw each time they Summon from the Deck or Extra Deck.

stops: **Ash Blossom on Branded Fusion.** You only have 1 copy. Have Albaz, Lukias or Faimena ready as the next play, or bait Ash with another search first.
**Discard costs.** Albaz, Lubellion, Faimena and Super Polymerization all discard a card. Count them: a hand of two cards can't pay for a three-step line.
**Albaz can't use your other monsters.** Its own effect fuses it only with monsters your **opponent** controls. Going first, use Branded Fusion or the Dracotail cards instead.

engines.t: Fallen of Albaz and the cards that find it. Every Albaz Fusion is Level 8 with 2500 or 3000 ATK, and which one you make depends on the second material.

Spell. Fusion Summons a monster that lists Fallen of Albaz, using 2 monsters from hand, **Deck** or field.
Summons herself if Albaz is on your field or in your GY. Quick Effect: Fusion Summon a Level 8+ Fusion using hand and field.
Summoned: send Albaz or a card that mentions it from Deck to GY. When a card leaves the Extra Deck, revive Albaz.
Quick-Play. Reveal a monster and send a matching Level 8 Fusion from the Extra Deck to the GY, then discard to add Albaz.
Quick-Play. Discard 1 to add or Summon a Despia monster (Aluber). In the GY it protects a Fusion from destruction.
Quick-Play. Send an Albaz Fusion from the Extra Deck to the GY to destroy a face-up card, or revive a monster if Ecclesia is on field or in GY.

engines.t: Dragons and Spellcasters. Each one, when sent to the GY as **Fusion Material**, Sets a Dracotail Spell/Trap from the Deck, and the three Dragons add removal on top.

key.t: Level 5. Quick Effect from hand: discard it to Fusion Summon a Dragon or Spellcaster. As material: Set.
Level 4. Summoned: add a Dracotail monster. As material: Set.
Level 3. Quick Effect: Fusion Summon a Dracotail Fusion. As material: Set, then negate 1 of their monsters.
Level 7. As material: Set, then destroy 1 monster.
Level 6. As material: Set, then destroy 1 Spell/Trap. From the GY: returns to the Deck to add a Dracotail Spellcaster back.
Spell. Adds a Dracotail monster. If they control a monster, also Fusion Summon.
Spell. Fusion Summons a Dracotail Fusion using hand, **Deck** or field.
Trap. Return an Attack Position monster to the hand or Extra Deck, recycle a Dracotail card and draw 1.

engines.t: The Albaz Fusions are chosen by the second material. The two Dracotail Fusions need a material from your hand.

key.t: Albaz + an Extra Deck monster. Quick Effect: send an Albaz Fusion from the Extra Deck to the GY to banish a monster. If they remove it, their monsters are destroyed in the End Phase.
Albaz + a DARK monster. Discard 1 to Fusion Summon again by shuffling materials from field, GY or banishment back into the Deck.
Albaz + a LIGHT Spellcaster. Can't be targeted. On their turn it revives 2 monsters, 1 to each field.
Albaz + a 2500+ ATK monster. Sent to the GY: in the End Phase, add or Summon Albaz from the Deck.
Dracotail + a monster in hand. Each turn, when you activate a Dracotail card or effect, destroy 1 of their cards.
Dracotail + monsters in hand. Returns monsters from the field or GYs to the hand, 1 per material used from your hand.

key.c: The Dragon that Devours the Dogma
key.t: Albaz + LIGHT/DARK + an Effect Monster. With Ecclesia on field or in a GY it is unaffected by other cards.
Albaz + a Beast, Beast-Warrior or Winged Beast. Negates an Extra Deck monster's effect and returns a monster to the hand.

cards: The Dragon that Devours the Dogma

engines.t: **Mulcharmy Fuwalos** ×3 and **Mulcharmy Purulia** ×2 draw cards as the opponent Summons, but only if you control no cards. Ash Blossom ×3, Effect Veiler ×2 and Droll & Lock Bird. **Super Polymerization** ×3 with Garura and Mudragon as its generic targets. All of them also serve as discards for your Fusion costs.

facts.t: **Every Extra Deck monster is a Fusion.** The "Fusion Monsters only" locks on Branded Fusion, Branded Opening, Fusion Deployment, Mululu, Rahu and Lubellion never cost you anything.
**Dracotail material effects work with any Fusion Summon.** Branded Fusion and Rahu Dracotail can take a Dracotail monster from the Deck as material, and it still Sets a card.
**Only three Dracotail Spells/Traps exist in the deck**: Ketu, Rahu and Horn. Once all three have left the Deck, a Dracotail material has nothing to Set and its extra effect doesn't happen either.
**Faimena discarded for her own effect is a cost, not Fusion Material.** She doesn't Set a card that way.
**Mirrorjade can't banish two turns in a row**, and you can only control 1.

**Incredible Ecclesia counts as an Ecclesia monster**, which turns on The Fallen & The Virtuous's revival and the Dogma dragon's protection. She can also Tribute herself to Summon Albaz from the Deck.
cards: The Dragon that Devours the Dogma

facts.t: **Mulcharmy monsters need you to control no cards.** Use them on their turn before you Set or Summon anything.

str: A Fusion for every situation, and Albaz uses the opponent's monsters as material.
Quick Effect Fusions from Faimena, Mululu, Cartesia and Super Polymerization.
Dracotail materials turn each Fusion Summon into a Set card plus removal.
Five Mulcharmy, three Ash Blossom and three Super Polymerization for going second.
weak: Branded Fusion, Ketu, Rahu and Mululu are all Limited to 1.
Almost every play discards a card, so the hand empties fast.
The engine lives in the GY: banishing effects hurt it.
Mulcharmy do nothing once you have cards on the field.

combos.h: Line A — Lukias + Faimena into Gulamel and Arthalion
combos.about: The Dracotail line. Lukias finds Mululu, and Faimena fuses them into Gulamel. Both materials Set a Spell from the Deck. Ketu finds Pan, and Rahu fuses Pan with Urgula **from the Deck** into Arthalion, which returns Faimena to your hand. You finish with two Fusions, a Set Trap and the Quick Effect Fusion ready again.

steps.t: **Normal Summon Lukias.** It adds Dracotail Mululu from your Deck.
Faimena's Quick Effect: discard her to **Fusion Summon Gulamel** using Lukias (field) + Mululu (hand).
Lukias and Mululu were used as Fusion Material: **Set Rahu Dracotail and Ketu Dracotail** from your Deck.
**Activate Ketu**: add Dracotail Pan from your Deck.
**Activate Rahu**: Fusion Summon **Arthalion** using Urgula from your Deck + Pan from your hand.
Arthalion returns Faimena from your GY to your hand. Urgula, used as material, **Sets Dracotail Horn** from your Deck.
Urgula's GY effect: put it on the bottom of your Deck and **add Lukias** from your GY to your hand.

end.t: Gulamel (2800) + Arthalion (3000) + a Set Dracotail Horn, with Faimena and Lukias back in hand. On their turn, Horn returns an Attack Position monster to the hand and draws you a card, and because Horn is a Dracotail card, Gulamel destroys 1 more of their cards.

rules: Normal Spells Set from the Deck can be activated the same turn. Dracotail Horn is a Trap, so it waits for their turn.
Going second, Mululu's material effect also negates one of their monsters, and Gulamel destroys a card when you activate Ketu.
Each Dracotail effect is once per turn by name.

combos.h: Line B — Aluber into Mirrorjade
combos.about: The Branded line. Aluber finds Branded Fusion, which takes Albaz from the Deck and fuses it with Aluber into Lubellion. Lubellion immediately fuses again, shuffling itself and Albaz back to make Mirrorjade. On their turn Mirrorjade banishes a monster, and the Fusion it sent to the GY brings a new Albaz out in the End Phase.

steps.t: **Normal Summon Aluber.** It adds Branded Fusion from your Deck.
**Activate Branded Fusion**: Fusion Summon **Lubellion** using Albaz from your Deck + Aluber on your field.
Lubellion's effect: discard 1 card, then shuffle Albaz (GY) and Lubellion (field) back to **Fusion Summon Mirrorjade**.
Their turn, Mirrorjade's Quick Effect: send Titaniklad from your Extra Deck to the GY and **banish 1 monster**.
Their End Phase: Titaniklad was sent to the GY this turn, so **Special Summon Albaz from your Deck**.
Albaz was Special Summoned: discard 1 card and **fuse Albaz with one of their monsters**.

end.t: You end your turn on Mirrorjade (3000 ATK) with Aluber in the GY. During their turn you banish one monster and fuse away another. If they remove Mirrorjade with a card effect, it destroys all their monsters in the End Phase and Aluber returns to negate a monster.

rules: This line discards twice: once for Lubellion and once for Albaz. Hand traps you don't need are the usual payment.
Mirrorjade's banish can't be used on the following turn.
Which Fusion Albaz makes in step 6 depends on their monster. See the next slide.

combos.h: Going second — Which Fusion to make
combos.about: **Fallen of Albaz** fuses with a monster your opponent controls when it is Summoned (discard 1). **Super Polymerization** fuses any two monsters on either field and can't be responded to. In both cases their monster is simply used as material, so protection from targeting and destruction doesn't help. Choose the Fusion by what their monster is:

rows.when: Albaz + a Fusion, Synchro, Xyz or Link
rows.t: The usual choice. Mirrorjade then banishes a second monster.
Gains ATK from both Levels, and finds another Albaz in the End Phase it goes to the GY.
Lubellion can then fuse again using materials from the field, GY or banishment.

rows.when: Albaz + a LIGHT Spellcaster, or a Dragon
rows.t: Albion can't be targeted. Alba-Lenatus can use several Dragons at once and attacks once per material.

rows.when: Albaz + a Beast, Beast-Warrior or Winged Beast
rows.t: Rindbrumm negates an Extra Deck monster's effect.

rows.when: Super Polymerization: two of their monsters
rows.t: Garura for the same Type and Attribute, Mudragon for the same Attribute, Secreterion for a Dragon + a Spellcaster.

rules: Albaz's own effect can't use your other monsters. Super Polymerization, Branded Fusion and the Dracotail cards can.
With Super Polymerization and Albaz on the field, two of their monsters plus Albaz make The Dragon that Devours the Dogma.

branded-dracotail.arch: Fusion toolbox. Fallen of Albaz/Branded Fusion builds Albaz Dragons; the Dracotail engine adds Quick-Effect Fusions and on-material Set/removal triggers; Mulcharmy ×5, Ash ×3 and Droll/Veiler handle going second.

dinomorphia-ryzeal.pitch: A Trap deck that spends its own Life Points on purpose. Each **Dinomorphia** Trap costs half your LP and Fusion Summons on the opponent's turn. The lower your LP, the stronger the Fusions: at 2000 LP **Rexterm** stops their monsters from activating effects at all. A **Ryzeal** Rank 4 package gives a second, safer opening.

plan.first: Normal Summon Therizia to Set **Dinomorphia Frenzy** from the Deck. On their turn Frenzy makes **Rexterm**, Rexterm halves your LP again, and their monsters are locked. Or open Ryzeal and end on **Detonator**.
plan.second: Thirteen hand traps slow them down first. Kashtira Fenrir Summons itself and banishes a card, the Ryzeal monsters build Detonator, and any Dinomorphia Trap you Set works on their next turn.
plan.win: Rexterm (3000 ATK) and Detonator (3000 ATK) attacking into monsters that can't use effects. Stealthbergia also burns them for a monster's ATK each time they activate a monster effect.

open.t: Normal Summon it to Set any Dinomorphia Trap straight from the Deck.
Adds Therizia, Diplos or Miscellaneousaurus.
Normal Summon it to Special Summon Sword Ryzeal from the Deck: two Level 4s from one card.
Drawn naturally it needs no monster at all: it fuses using 1 monster from your Deck and 1 from your Extra Deck.
Special Summons itself on an empty field and banishes face-down.

stops: **Your Life Points.** Two Dinomorphia effects take you from 8000 to 2000. That is the goal, but a direct attack or burn can now finish you. Keep a Dinomorphia Trap in the GY: banishing it stops effect damage for a turn.
**Spell/Trap removal.** Frenzy is Set for a whole turn before it can be used. Against decks with lots of removal, hold Infinite Impermanence or open with Ryzeal instead.
**Engine locks.** A Ryzeal monster that Summons itself locks you to Rank 4 Xyz Monsters for the turn, so no Fusion on that turn. The lock ends with your turn, so a Set Frenzy still works on theirs.

engines.t: Level 4 Dinosaurs that fetch Traps, Traps that Fusion Summon for half your LP, and Fusions that reward low LP. All the Fusions float: when destroyed they revive a smaller Dinomorphia from the GY.

key.t: Summoned: Set a Dinomorphia Trap from the Deck.
Summoned: send a Dinomorphia card from the Deck to the GY.
Trap, their Main Phase only. Pay half your LP: Fusion Summon using exactly 1 monster from your Deck and 1 from your Extra Deck.
Trap, either Main Phase. Pay half your LP: Fusion Summon using monsters from hand, Deck or field.
Trap. Pay half your LP: revive up to 2 Dinomorphia monsters whose Levels total 8 or less.
Level 8, 3000 ATK. Their monsters with ATK equal to or higher than your LP can't activate effects. Quick Effect: pay half your LP to make all their monsters' ATK equal to your LP.
Level 6. 4000 ATK minus your LP. Quick Effect: copy a Dinomorphia Trap from your GY.
Level 6. At 2000 LP or less your Traps and Dinomorphia effects cost no LP. Burns them when they activate a monster effect.

engines.t: Level 4 monsters that Summon each other and overlay into Rank 4 Xyz Monsters. This half costs no Life Points.

key.t: Normal Summoned: Special Summon a Ryzeal from the Deck. Can also Summon itself by sending 1 card from hand or field to the GY.
Summons itself if a Ryzeal is on your field or in your GY. Summoned: add a LIGHT Pyro monster (Ice or Ext).
Summons itself by sending an Xyz Monster from your Extra Deck to the GY. Summoned: add a FIRE Thunder monster (Sword).
Spell. Adds a Level 4 or lower Pyro monster: Ice or Ext.
Rank 4. Detach 2 materials from your monsters to add 2 Ryzeal cards with different names.
Rank 4, 3000 ATK. Quick Effect: when they activate a card or effect, detach 1 to destroy 1 card on the field.
Rank 9 that you never Summon. Ext sends it from the Extra Deck as its cost, and it then negates a face-up card from the GY.

engines.t: **Kashtira Fenrir** ×2 with **Pressured Planet Wraitsoth** to find it. **Fossil Dig** ×3 adds a Dinosaur. **Miscellaneousaurus** protects your Dinosaurs for a Main Phase. **Trap Trick** Sets a second copy of Frenzy, Domain or Impermanence from the Deck, ready to use that turn. Pot of Prosperity digs for a starter.

Ash Blossom ×3, Effect Veiler ×3, Infinite Impermanence ×3, Ghost Ogre ×2, Ghost Belle, Droll and Nibiru: thirteen ways to interrupt. Salamangreat Almiraj, Dharc, Psychic End Punisher and TY-PHON are single-card answers in the Extra Deck.

facts.t: **"Pay half your LP" is a cost.** You pay it even if the Trap is negated. From 8000 the steps are 4000, 2000, 1000.
**Rexterm compares their monsters' ATK to your LP.** After its Quick Effect sets their ATK equal to your LP, none of the monsters they control at that moment can activate effects.

**Frenzy needs both materials to come from the right place**: 1 from the Deck, 1 from the Extra Deck. For Rexterm that is Kentregina or Stealthbergia from the Extra Deck + Therizia or Diplos from the Deck.
**At 2000 LP or less, a Dinomorphia Trap in your GY can be banished** when they activate anything: you take no effect damage that turn.
**Ryzeal locks only apply when a Ryzeal uses its own Summon from hand.** Ice Normal Summoned, or Sword brought out by Ice's effect, causes no lock.
**Trap Trick needs two copies of the Trap left in your Deck**: it banishes one and Sets another. After it you can activate only 1 more Trap that turn.
**Fenrir can't Summon itself once you control a monster.** If you have it, it is your first play.

str: Rexterm at low LP stops monster effects entirely.
Frenzy fuses from Deck and Extra Deck, so it needs no monsters on the field.
Ryzeal is a one-card start that costs no LP and makes a 3000 ATK Quick Effect destroyer.
Thirteen hand traps.
weak: Low LP makes burn and direct attacks dangerous.
Set Traps are slow and exposed to removal for a turn.
Ryzeal's Rank 4 lock keeps the two engines on separate turns.
Rexterm doesn't affect monsters Summoned after its effect, or Spells and Traps.

combos.h: Line A — Therizia into Rexterm
combos.about: The Dinomorphia plan. Therizia Sets Frenzy from the Deck and you pass. In their Main Phase Frenzy fuses a monster from your Deck with one from your Extra Deck into Rexterm, at the cost of half your LP. Rexterm then pays half again. You are at 2000 LP, every monster they control has 2000 ATK, and none of them can activate effects.

steps.t: Activate Fossil Dig: **add Dinomorphia Therizia**.
**Normal Summon Therizia.** It Sets Dinomorphia Frenzy directly from your Deck.
Their Main Phase: **activate Frenzy** and pay half your LP (8000 → 4000).
Frenzy **Fusion Summons Rexterm** using Kentregina from your Extra Deck + Diplos from your Deck.
Rexterm's Quick Effect: pay half your LP (4000 → 2000). **All their monsters' ATK becomes 2000.**
Their monsters now have ATK equal to your LP, so **they can't activate those monsters' effects**.

end.t: Rexterm (3000 ATK) + Therizia at 2000 LP, with their monsters reduced to 2000 ATK and their effects switched off. Frenzy is in your GY: banish it when they activate something and you take no effect damage this turn.

rules: Activate Frenzy early in their Main Phase, before they have used their monsters' effects.
If Rexterm is destroyed it revives a Level 6 or lower Dinomorphia from your GY, such as Kentregina.
Dinomorphia Domain does the same job on **your** turn and can use Therizia from the field as material.

combos.h: Line B — Ice Ryzeal into Detonator
combos.about: The Ryzeal plan, from one Normal Summon and with no LP cost. Ice brings Sword from the Deck and Sword finds Ext. Ice + Sword overlay into Duo Drive, which adds two more Ryzeals. Ext Summons itself by sending Mereologic Aggregator from the Extra Deck, and Ext + the second Sword make Detonator.

steps.t: **Normal Summon Ice Ryzeal.** It Special Summons Sword Ryzeal from your Deck, and Sword adds Ext Ryzeal.
**Xyz Summon Ryzeal Duo Drive** (Rank 4) using Ice + Sword.
Duo Drive's effect: detach both materials to **add a second Sword Ryzeal and a second Ice Ryzeal**.
Send Mereologic Aggregator from your Extra Deck to the GY to **Special Summon Ext Ryzeal**. Aggregator can negate 1 face-up card.
A Ryzeal is on your field: **Special Summon Sword Ryzeal** from your hand.
**Xyz Summon Ryzeal Detonator** using Ext + Sword. It attaches a Ryzeal from your GY as a third material.

end.t: Detonator (3000 ATK, 3 materials) + Duo Drive, with Ice Ryzeal in hand. When they activate a card or effect, Detonator detaches 1 material to destroy 1 card on the field. It can also detach to save your Xyz Monsters from destruction.

rules: Bonfire (add Ice) and Sword Ryzeal with any Ryzeal in the GY start the same line.
From step 4 you can only Special Summon Rank 4 Xyz Monsters from the Extra Deck this turn.
If you drew a Dinomorphia Trap, Set it now. The lock is over by the time you use it on their turn.

combos.h: Line C — Fenrir first (going second)
combos.about: Kashtira Fenrir Summons itself only on an empty field, so it comes before your Normal Summon. Wraitsoth finds it. Fenrir then banishes one of their face-up cards face-down when it attacks, and your Normal Summon is still free for Therizia or Ice Ryzeal.

steps.t: **Activate Pressured Planet Wraitsoth**: add Kashtira Fenrir.
You control no monsters: **Special Summon Fenrir** from your hand. Its effect adds your second Fenrir.
**Normal Summon Therizia** and Set Dinomorphia Frenzy from your Deck.
Fenrir declares an attack: **banish 1 face-up card they control, face-down**.

end.t: Fenrir + Therizia with Frenzy Set. One of their cards is gone for good, and on their turn Frenzy makes Rexterm while Fenrir banishes another card when they activate a monster effect.

rules: Wraitsoth gives your monsters 100 ATK/DEF for each different Attribute on the field.
Fenrir's search and its banish are each once per turn.
With Ice Ryzeal instead of Therizia, play Line B after Fenrir. Fenrir doesn't lock anything.

dinomorphia-ryzeal.arch: Dinomorphia Trap-Fusion floodgate (low-LP Rexterm lock) with a Ryzeal Rank 4 toolbox and a small Kashtira Fenrir package; heavy hand-trap density (3 Ash, 3 Veiler, 3 Impermanence, 2 Ghost Ogre, Ghost Belle, Droll, Nibiru).

metalmorph-fiendsmith.pitch: A deck built around one Trap. **Max Metalmorph** Tributes one of your monsters and Summons a Machine boss from the Deck, then equips itself to that boss as protection. Which boss you get depends on what you Tribute: a Dragon gives a negate, a Fiend gives repeated destruction. The **Fiendsmith** engine adds a second boss that needs no Normal Summon.

plan.first: Zoa or Metal Illusionist Sets Max Metalmorph, **Red-Eyes Metal Claws Dragon** lets you use it the same turn, and you end on **Metalzoa X** or **Red-Eyes Black Fullmetal Dragon**. Fiendsmith adds **Desirae**, which negates up to 3 cards.
plan.second: Forbidden Droplet, Infinite Impermanence and Super Polymerization break their board first. Zoa can be Normal Summoned without Tributing when they control a monster.
plan.win: 3400 to 3800 ATK bosses that can't be targeted or destroyed by monster effects or Spells. Fullmetal also burns them for a monster's ATK each time it negates.

open.t: Summons itself from hand, then Sets Max Metalmorph from the Deck. It is also the Level 7 Fiend you Tribute.
Send a face-down card to Summon it. While it is on the field, Metalmorph Traps can be activated the turn they are Set.
Adds any monster that mentions Max Metalmorph, or the Trap itself, from Deck or GY.
Reveal it in your hand to add Zoa, Metal Claws or any card that mentions Max Metalmorph. It shuffles itself back.
Discard it to add Fiendsmith's Tract. That starts the Fiendsmith line with no Normal Summon.

stops: **Max Metalmorph is a Trap.** Without Metal Claws on the field it waits a turn, face-down, where it can be destroyed. Find Metal Claws, or Set it behind Infinite Impermanence.

**The right Tribute.** Fullmetal needs a Level 5+ **Dragon**, Metalzoa X a Level 5+ **Fiend**, Metalflame Swordsman a Level 5+ **Warrior**. The Tribute is a cost: if Max is negated, the monster is gone anyway.

Vision is activated to add Mystical Space Typhoon, and that activation lets Meghala bring Fonix from the Deck. Eldam and Meghala then Link into Marine Eidolon for a second Typhoon. Both are Set for their turn.

**Special Summon Meghala** from your hand the same way.
**Activate Vision**: add Mystical Space Typhoon from your Deck.
A Radiant Typhoon Quick-Play was activated: Meghala **Special Summons Fonix from your Deck**.

combos.about: The Angelechy package, played first because Meghala would lock it out. Problem Summons Enlisted and places Destrier, which finds Opposition. Destrier was placed: **add Angelechy Opposition**.
Activate Opposition: Special Summon your second Enlisted to their field, in a column next to yours, and **place Bastion**.
Your Enlisted's effect: **banish their Enlisted**. Yours moves to their field and returns to your Extra Deck.
Enlisted changed control, so you **Special Summon your second Destrier** from the Extra Deck as a monster.

end.t: Destrier (2500 ATK) on the field with Destrier and Bastion as Continuous Spells. Each card or effect they activate costs them 500 LP, and Bastion protects your Angelechy cards from destruction. The discarded Typhoon is in your GY, which turns on the Level 3 Radiant Typhoons.

On your next turn the monster Destrier banishes 1 monster in a different column.

lunalight.pitch: A Fusion deck of DARK Beast-Warriors that want to be **sent to the GY by card effects**: each one does something when that happens, and Fusion Summoning is the easiest way to do it. The bosses are a chain of Dancers, each made from the one before. **Kaleido Chick** skips the chain by pretending to be any Dancer you send from the Extra Deck.

plan.first: Gold Leo finds Silver Hound, Silver Hound brings Kaleido Chick from the Deck, and Polymerization makes **Leo Dancer** or **Liger Dancer** on turn one. Silver Hound in the GY then negates a Spell or Trap.
plan.second: The same Fusion, used to attack. Leo Dancer destroys every Special Summoned monster they control after it attacks one, and attacks twice. Lunalight Fusion can take a material from your Deck when they control an Extra Deck monster.
plan.win: One huge Dancer: Leo Dancer (3500, two attacks) or Liger Dancer (3800, two attacks, unaffected by their cards).

open.t: Normal Summon it to add any Lunalight and discard a card. Discard Silver Hound and the combo starts.
Discard it to add Polymerization from the Deck, or to take a Lunalight back from the GY.
Adds Gold Leo, or any Level 4 or lower Beast-Warrior.
Send it from hand to send Silver Hound from the Deck to the GY, which Summons a Lunalight from the Deck.
The Fusion Spell. Kaleido Chick returns it from the GY each time she is used as material.

stops: **"Sent to the GY by a card effect."** Being discarded by Gold Leo's effect or used as Fusion Material counts. Being discarded as a **cost** (Black Sheep's own effect) does not.

**Silver Hound's lock.** While the monster it Summoned stays face-up, only Lunalight monsters can come from your Extra Deck. Guardian Chimera, Chaos Angel, Tiger King and the Links wait until it is gone.
**Ash Blossom on Gold Leo.** It stops the search and the discard. Keep Tenki, Fraktall or Foolish Burial Goods as a second way to start.

engines.t: Each has one effect on the field or in hand and a second that triggers when a card effect sends it to the GY. Every effect is once per turn by name.

Sent to the GY by an effect: Special Summon a Lunalight from the Deck. From the GY: banish it and a Lunalight Fusion to negate a Spell/Trap activation.

Continuous Spell. Sends a Lunalight from Deck to GY the turn it is activated, and returns Polymerization when you Fusion Summon.

Trap. Its GY effect is the point: banish it and send 1 card from your hand to Summon a Lunalight from the Deck.

Pendulum. In a Pendulum Zone it Fusion Summons by banishing materials from your field or GY.

engines.t: A ladder: Cat, Panther, Leo, Liger. Each step needs the previous Dancer by name plus more Lunalights. Kaleido Chick lets you start on any rung.

key.t: Level 6, 2 Lunalights. Adds Luna Light Perfume. From the GY: their monsters lose ATK equal to their DEF for the turn.
Level 7, 2 Lunalights. Tribute a Lunalight: it attacks every monster they control twice.
Level 8, Cat Dancer + 1. Attacks every monster twice, and can't be destroyed by their effects.
Level 10, Panther Dancer + 2. 3500 ATK, two attacks, can't be targeted or destroyed by their effects. After attacking a monster: destroy all their Special Summoned monsters.
Level 12, Leo Dancer + 3. 3800 ATK, two attacks, unaffected by non-Lunalight cards. Quick Effect: destroy all their Special Summoned monsters.
Level 9, any 3 Lunalights. Can't be targeted. Gains 200 ATK for each Beast-Warrior banished or in the GYs.
Level 9, 3 different names from hand and field. Draws for each hand material and destroys for each field material.

engines.t: **Fire Formation - Tenki** ×2 and **Foolish Burial** find or bury the right Lunalight. Infinite Impermanence ×3, Ash Blossom ×2, Effect Veiler ×2, Nibiru and Droll are the hand traps. Chaos Angel, Tiger King, Underworld Goddess, S:P Little Knight and I:P Masquerena are the non-Lunalight Extra Deck options.

facts.t: **Kaleido Chick can send a Fusion Monster from the Extra Deck** and take its name. Send Panther Dancer to make Leo Dancer with 3 materials. Send Leo Dancer to make Liger Dancer with 4.
**Panther, Leo and Liger must be Fusion Summoned with their named materials.** Kaleido Chick's name change satisfies that.
**Silver Hound's negate needs a Lunalight Fusion Monster in your GY** to banish with it. The Dancer that Kaleido Chick sent from the Extra Deck is exactly that.
**Gold Leo's discard is part of its effect**, so the discarded Lunalight was "sent to the GY by a card effect" and triggers. Gold Leo then returns one Lunalight that went to the GY, once per turn.
**Heavy Polymerization costs LP.** Banishing Panther Dancer from the Extra Deck as material for Leo Dancer costs 2800 LP, and you can banish at most as many monsters as they control.
**Fraktall's Link Summon effect has no target**: there is no Beast, Beast-Warrior or Winged Beast Link in the Extra Deck. Use only its first effect.
**Lunalight Serenade Dance counts as a Lunalight Spell/Trap**, so Yellow Marten can search it. Sent to the GY by Foolish Burial Goods, it Summons a Lunalight from the Deck next.

str: Two cards make Leo Dancer, three make Liger Dancer, on the first turn.
Leo and Liger Dancer clear every Special Summoned monster and attack twice.
Polymerization keeps coming back through Kaleido Chick and Masquerade.
Silver Hound in the GY is a free Spell/Trap negate.
