Silver Hound's lock keeps the generic Extra Deck out.
Banishing or negating the GY effects breaks the chain.
Only nine interaction cards.

combos.h: Line A — Gold Leo into Liger Dancer
combos.about: Liger Dancer normally needs four Fusions in a row. Kaleido Chick replaces three of them: she sends Leo Dancer from the Extra Deck to the GY and counts as Leo Dancer herself. Gold Leo finds Silver Hound and discards it, Silver Hound brings Kaleido from the Deck, and Polymerization fuses four Lunalights at once.

steps.t: **Normal Summon Gold Leo.** It adds Silver Hound, then you discard Silver Hound.
Silver Hound was sent to the GY by an effect: **Special Summon Kaleido Chick** from your Deck. Gold Leo returns Silver Hound to your hand.
Kaleido Chick's effect: **send Leo Dancer** from your Extra Deck to the GY. Kaleido now counts as Leo Dancer for a Fusion.
**Activate Polymerization**: Fusion Summon **Liger Dancer** using Kaleido (as Leo Dancer) + Gold Leo + Silver Hound + Black Sheep.
Kaleido Chick returns Polymerization to your hand. Black Sheep, used as material, **adds Gold Leo** from your GY.

end.t: Liger Dancer (3800 ATK), unaffected by every card that isn't a Lunalight, with Polymerization and Gold Leo back in hand. On either turn it sends a Lunalight from your Extra Deck to destroy all their Special Summoned monsters. Silver Hound in the GY can banish itself and Leo Dancer to negate a Spell or Trap.

rules: Each Lunalight effect is once per turn by name. The Silver Hound that returned to your hand can't Summon from the Deck again this turn.
While Kaleido Chick is face-up, only Lunalight monsters can come from the Extra Deck. Liger Dancer is one.
No third Lunalight in hand? Make Leo Dancer instead (Line B).

combos.h: Line B — Gold Leo + Black Sheep into Leo Dancer
combos.about: The two-card version. It starts the same way, then Black Sheep discards itself to fetch Polymerization from the Deck. Kaleido Chick sends Panther Dancer this time, so the Fusion is Leo Dancer and needs only three materials.

steps.t: **Normal Summon Gold Leo.** It adds Silver Hound, then you discard Silver Hound.
Silver Hound **Special Summons Kaleido Chick** from your Deck. Gold Leo returns Silver Hound to your hand.
Discard Black Sheep: **add Polymerization** from your Deck.
Kaleido Chick's effect: **send Panther Dancer** from your Extra Deck to the GY. Kaleido counts as Panther Dancer.
**Activate Polymerization**: Fusion Summon **Leo Dancer** using Kaleido (as Panther Dancer) + Gold Leo + Silver Hound.
Kaleido Chick was sent to the GY by an effect: **return Polymerization** to your hand.

end.t: Leo Dancer (3500 ATK) with Polymerization in hand. They can't target it or destroy it with card effects. It attacks twice, and after it attacks a monster it destroys every Special Summoned monster they control. Silver Hound and Panther Dancer in the GY are a Spell/Trap negate.

rules: Fire Formation - Tenki adds Gold Leo, so Tenki + Black Sheep is the same line.
Black Sheep discarded for its own effect is a cost, so it doesn't trigger. That is fine here: you only want the Polymerization.
Going second, attack a monster with Leo Dancer first, clear their field with its effect, then make the second attack directly.

combos.h: Line C — Fraktall start
combos.about: For hands without Gold Leo. Fraktall sends Silver Hound from the Deck to the GY, and Silver Hound Summons Gold Leo from the Deck. Gold Leo adds Kaleido Chick, which you Normal Summon. Black Sheep fetches Polymerization and Gold Leo takes Black Sheep straight back, so it is still there as the third material.

steps.t: Send Fraktall from your hand to the GY: **send Silver Hound** from your Deck to the GY.
Silver Hound **Special Summons Gold Leo** from your Deck. Gold Leo adds Kaleido Chick, then you discard 1 card (here Effect Veiler).
**Normal Summon Kaleido Chick** and send Panther Dancer from your Extra Deck to the GY.
Discard Black Sheep: **add Polymerization**. Gold Leo returns Black Sheep from the GY to your hand.
**Activate Polymerization**: Fusion Summon **Leo Dancer** using Kaleido (as Panther Dancer) + Gold Leo + Black Sheep.
Kaleido returns Polymerization. Black Sheep, used as material, **adds Gold Leo** from your GY.

end.t: Leo Dancer (3500 ATK) with Polymerization and Gold Leo in hand for next turn. Silver Hound and Panther Dancer in the GY give you the Spell/Trap negate.

rules: Foolish Burial (send Silver Hound) starts this line the same way.
Foolish Burial Goods sends Serenade Dance: banish it and send a card from your hand to Summon Gold Leo from the Deck.
Use only Fraktall's first effect. Its second effect needs a Link Monster the deck doesn't run.

lunalight.arch: Lunalight DARK Beast-Warrior Fusion engine with the Dancer chain, a small Tri-Brigade Fraktall / Fire Formation - Tenki / Tiger King package and a hand-trap suite (3 Impermanence, 2 Ash, 2 Effect Veiler, Nibiru, Droll).

spright.pitch: Everything here is a 2. **Spright** monsters are Level 2s that Special Summon themselves from your hand whenever you control a Level 2, searching as they arrive. Two of them overlay into the Rank 2 **Gigantic Spright**, which pulls another from the Deck. Spright Red and Carrot then negate the opponent's effects by Tributing your other 2s.

plan.first: End on **Gigantic Spright + Spright Red + Spright Carrot** with Spright Smashers Set. Red negates a monster effect, Carrot negates a Spell/Trap, and Smashers banishes a card.
plan.second: This is the deck's better side: 3 Nibiru, 3 Evenly Matched, 3 Super Polymerization, Feather Duster and Droplet. Break their board first, then build the Spright board in Main Phase 2. Nadir Servant adds a Dogmatika finish.
plan.win: The opponent runs out of cards against your negates and hand traps. Gigantic Spright has 3200 ATK with an Extra Deck monster as material, and Fleurdelis attacks for 3000.

open.t: Quick-Play. Special Summons any Spright from the Deck (you lose LP equal to its ATK). Starts everything by itself.
Special Summoned: add a Spright Spell/Trap: Starter or Smashers.
Special Summoned: add any Spright monster.
Sends a monster from the Extra Deck to the GY and adds a Dogmatika monster. Sending N'tss destroys a card.
Going second, from your hand with an empty field: they banish cards until they control as many as you.

stops: **You need a Level 2 on the field first.** Sprights only Summon themselves next to a Level, Rank or Link 2 monster. Starter provides one from the Deck; otherwise Normal Summon one.
**Blue and Jet only search when Special Summoned.** Normal Summon the one you need least and Special Summon the searchers.

**Lock order.** Starter and Gigantic Spright limit you to Level/Rank/Link 2 Special Summons. Nadir Servant and Ecclesia's search shut off your Extra Deck. Decide which engine this turn belongs to before you start.

engines.t: Level 2 Thunder monsters. Blue and Jet build your hand, Red and Carrot are the negates, and Gigantic Spright turns two of them into three.

key.t: Summons itself next to a Level/Rank 2. Special Summoned: add a Spright monster.
Summons itself next to a Level/Rank 2. Special Summoned: add a Spright Spell/Trap.
Quick Effect: Tribute another Level/Rank/Link 2 monster to negate a monster effect. If the Tribute was Rank or Link 2, also destroy that monster.
The same for a Spell/Trap card or effect.
Quick-Play. Special Summon a Spright from the Deck and lose LP equal to its ATK. Level/Rank/Link 2 Summons only afterwards.
Rank 2 Xyz. Detach 1 material to Special Summon a Level 2 from the Deck. Link-2 monsters can be its material.
Quick-Play. Banish a Spright card from hand or GY, then banish one of your 2s and 1 card they control.
Link-2. Sends a Level 2 from Deck to GY, or returns a monster to the hand when another monster is Special Summoned.

engines.t: A small package that uses the Extra Deck as a resource without Summoning from it. Nadir Servant chooses the effect by what it sends.

key.t: Send an Extra Deck monster to the GY, then add a Dogmatika monster with equal or lower ATK. No Extra Deck Summons afterwards this turn.
Never Summoned. Sent to the GY by Nadir Servant, it destroys 1 card on the field. 2500 ATK, so it finds Fleurdelis.
Sent to the GY by Nadir Servant, it draws 1 card. 1500 ATK, so it finds Ecclesia.
Summons herself if an Extra Deck monster is on the field. Adds a Dogmatika card (Fleurdelis).
Quick Effect: Summons itself if an Extra Deck monster is on the field, then negates a monster if you control another Dogmatika.

engines.t: Almost all Link-2: **S:P Little Knight** banishes, **I:P Masquerena** Links on their turn, **Knightmare Phoenix** destroys a Spell/Trap, **Dharc** takes a DARK monster from their GY. **Knightmare Unicorn** shuffles a card away, **Accesscode Talker** finishes games, and **Underworld Goddess** uses their monster as material.
cards: Underworld Goddess of the Closed World

engines.t: **Nibiru** ×3, **Evenly Matched** ×3 and **Super Polymerization** ×3 are the board breakers, with Harpie's Feather Duster and Forbidden Droplet. Ash Blossom ×3, Infinite Impermanence ×3, Effect Veiler, Ghost Ogre and Droll are the hand traps. Pot of Prosperity digs for whichever you need.

facts.t: **Spright Starter costs LP equal to the monster's ATK.** Jet costs 1300 and searches. Carrot costs 1000 and doesn't. You can activate only 1 Starter per turn.
**Red and Carrot destroy as well as negate only if the Tribute was a Rank 2 or Link 2 monster.** Tributing Gigantic Spright gets both; Tributing a Level 2 only negates.
**Gigantic Spright's effect locks both players** to Level/Rank/Link 2 Special Summons for the rest of the turn.
**Elder Entity N'tss can't be Summoned here**: it needs a Synchro Monster and the Extra Deck has none. It is only there for Nadir Servant to send.
**Ecclesia's search and Nadir Servant both stop your Extra Deck Summons for the turn.** Make Gigantic Spright first if you want both.
**Dharc can only add a DARK monster with 1500 or less DEF** when destroyed: Spright Blue or Jet.
**Evenly Matched from your hand needs you to control no cards.** Skip Main Phase 1, use it at the end of the Battle Phase, and play in Main Phase 2.

str: Spright Starter is a one-card route to the full board.
Red, Carrot and Smashers give three different answers on the opponent's turn.
Nineteen hand traps and breakers: the strongest going-second package in the collection.
Dogmatika gets removal and card draw out of Extra Deck cards you would never Summon.
weak: Without Starter you need two Sprights or a Normal Summon to begin.
The Starter, Gigantic and Dogmatika locks all restrict the same turn.
Low ATK: the board wins by negating, not by fighting.
Starter's LP cost adds up over a long game.

combos.h: Line A — Starter into the Spright board
combos.about: Two cards, no Normal Summon. Starter brings Jet from the Deck, and Jet finds Smashers. Blue Summons itself because a Level 2 is on the field, and finds Red, which does the same. Jet + Blue overlay into Gigantic Spright, and Gigantic detaches a material to bring Carrot from the Deck.

steps.t: **Activate Spright Starter**: Special Summon Jet from your Deck (you lose 1300 LP). Jet adds Spright Smashers.
You control a Level 2: **Special Summon Blue** from your hand. Blue adds Spright Red.
**Special Summon Red** from your hand the same way.
**Xyz Summon Gigantic Spright** (Rank 2) using Jet + Blue.
Gigantic's effect: detach 1 material to **Special Summon Carrot** from your Deck.
**Set Spright Smashers.** You still have your Normal Summon.

end.t: Gigantic Spright + Red + Carrot with Smashers Set. Red Tributes Gigantic to negate a monster effect and destroy that monster. Carrot Tributes another 2 to negate a Spell or Trap. Smashers banishes a Spright from your GY, then one of your 2s and one of their cards.

rules: No Starter? Normal Summon any Spright, then Special Summon Jet and Blue next to it for their searches.
After Starter you can only Special Summon Level, Rank or Link 2 monsters this turn.
Each Spright can Summon itself from hand once per turn, and each search is once per turn.

combos.h: Line B — Nadir Servant and Dogmatika (going second)
combos.about: Nadir Servant sends a monster from your Extra Deck to the GY and adds a Dogmatika monster with ATK equal to or lower than it. Send Elder Entity N'tss: it destroys a card, and its 2500 ATK finds Fleurdelis. Their Extra Deck monsters let Ecclesia and Fleurdelis Summon themselves, and Fleurdelis negates a monster.

steps.t: **Activate Nadir Servant**: send Elder Entity N'tss from your Extra Deck to the GY and add Fleurdelis.
N'tss was sent to the GY: **destroy 1 card on the field**.
An Extra Deck monster is on the field: **Special Summon Ecclesia** from your hand.
Fleurdelis's Quick Effect: **Special Summon it** from your hand, then negate 1 face-up monster until the end of the turn.
When a Dogmatika attacks, Fleurdelis gives all your Dogmatika monsters 500 ATK: **Fleurdelis 3000, Ecclesia 2000**.

end.t: One card destroyed, their best monster negated, and 5000 ATK of Dogmatika monsters attacking. Ecclesia can't be destroyed in battle by monsters from the Extra Deck.

rules: Sending Garura instead draws 1 card and adds Ecclesia (1500 ATK), who then searches Fleurdelis.
After Nadir Servant you can't Special Summon from the Extra Deck this turn. Sprights from hand and Deck are still fine.
Ecclesia and Fleurdelis need a monster that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck on the field, either player's.

combos.h: Line C — Evenly Matched, then Sprights
combos.about: The standard going-second turn. Evenly Matched can be activated from your hand if you control no cards, at the end of the Battle Phase. So you play nothing in Main Phase 1, walk into the Battle Phase, and make them banish their field down to one card. Then you build Line A in Main Phase 2.

steps.t: Main Phase 1: **play nothing**, so that you control no cards. Go to the Battle Phase.
End of the Battle Phase: **activate Evenly Matched from your hand**. They banish cards face-down until they control 1.
Main Phase 2: **activate Spright Starter** and Special Summon Jet from your Deck.
Play the rest of Line A: Blue, Red, **Gigantic Spright**, Carrot.

end.t: They are down to one card, banished face-down so that nothing triggers, and they face Gigantic Spright, Red and Carrot.

The materials are sent to the GY without being targeted or destroyed, so their protection doesn't help. Pick the Fusion by what the two monsters share:

gren-maju.pitch: A control deck with ten monsters. Continuous cards switch off what most decks rely on: the Graveyard, monster effects and Special Summons. Meanwhile your own cards pile up in the banished zone, and **Gren Maju Da Eiza** has 400 ATK for every one of them. Lock the game, then attack once with a 7000 ATK Level 3.

plan.first: Normal Summon **Inspector Boarder**, activate **Necrovalley** or Dimensional Fissure, and Set **Macro Cosmos** with a Solemn Trap. They must play through all of it with no GY and almost no monster effects.
plan.second: Raigeki, Evenly Matched and Super Polymerization break their board, or **Fallen of Albaz** fuses with their best monster. Then Pot of Desires and Gizmek Orochi banish 18 of your cards in one turn.
plan.win: Gren Maju Da Eiza. Pot of Desires (10) plus Gizmek Orochi (8) makes it 7200 ATK, and Clockwork Night adds 500 more.

The rest of the Extra Deck is mostly there to be banished by Pot of Prosperity and Orochi.

**Solemn Judgment** and **Solemn Strike** negate a Summon or an activation. **Infinite Impermanence** ×3 negates a monster. **Evenly Matched** ×2 and **Raigeki** clear a field going second, and Nibiru punishes a long combo. Traps are not monster effects, so Inspector Boarder doesn't limit them.

facts.t: **Macro Cosmos is a Trap and must be Set for a turn.** Dimensional Fissure, Necrovalley and Clockwork Night are Spells and work immediately.
**Dimensional Fissure only banishes monsters.** Spells and Traps still go to the GY. Macro Cosmos banishes everything.
**Necrovalley and the banish cards work together.** Macro Cosmos stops cards reaching the GY, and Necrovalley protects whatever is already there from being touched.
**Inspector Boarder limits your own monsters.** Albaz, Gizmek Orochi and Nibiru all use monster effects. Gren Maju has none, so it is unaffected.
**Gizmek Orochi gets one effect per turn**, either the Summon or the destroy, not both.

combos.h: Plan A — Turn-one lock
combos.about: The control opening. Pot of Duality finds whichever piece is missing. Inspector Boarder is Normal Summoned onto an empty field, a floodgate Spell goes face-up, and Macro Cosmos is Set with a Solemn Trap beside it. Nothing here needs a Special Summon, so Duality's restriction costs nothing.

steps.t: **Activate Pot of Duality**: reveal your top 3 cards and add 1 to your hand.
**Normal Summon Inspector Boarder** while you control no monsters.
**Activate Necrovalley** in your Field Zone.
**Set Macro Cosmos and Solemn Judgment.**
Their turn: **flip Macro Cosmos** as soon as you can. Use Solemn Judgment on the card that would break the lock.

end.t: Inspector Boarder + Necrovalley + Macro Cosmos, backed by Solemn Judgment. With no Extra Deck monster on the field they can activate no monster effects at all. Their GY is frozen, and every card they lose from now on is banished.

rules: Dimensional Fissure does Macro Cosmos's job for monsters and doesn't have to wait a turn.
Don't Set Infinite Impermanence in the same column as your face-up Continuous Spells. If it was Set, it negates other Spell/Trap effects in its column for the turn.
Solemn Judgment costs half your LP. Save it for a Feather Duster or a boss monster.
